subject: ISO / FedRAMP evidence retention & control mapping — staging questions
messages:
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com (Sergio Alvarez)
To: security@acme-analytics.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ISO / FedRAMP evidence retention & control mapping — staging questions

Hi Julia / Acme security team,

Thanks again for the SIG/CUSTOMER intake call yesterday. We started mapping controls for both ISO 27001 and FedRAMP; before we hand over a packaged evidence set, a few quick clarification items so we can stage the export correctly: 

- Retention windows: for FedRAMP controls, do you require 3 years of raw logs + 1 year of parsed/aggregated evidence, or is staff-level attestations + 1 year sufficient for low/moderate?
- Sampling window: are you expecting continuous sample coverage (rolling 90 days) or a static snapshot period (e.g., Jan 1–Jun 30, 2026)?
- Accepted log formats: we can produce raw syslog, CloudTrail JSON, and a CSV index. Do you need signed (chain-of-custody) hashes for exported artifacts?
- Control owners: please confirm if you expect named control owners in the package or if role-based owners (e.g., "Platform Security") are OK.

Attached: evidence-index.csv (preview of records we will export) and retention-policy-draft.pdf (our proposed retention mapping).

Planned timeline: we can prepare the first export for your review by Aug 20, then iterate. If any of the above require a different cadence let me know.

Thanks,

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence-index.csv (csv)]
[Attachment: retention-policy-draft.pdf (pdf)]

From: julia.wong@acme-analytics.com (Julia Wong)
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ISO / FedRAMP evidence retention & control mapping — staging questions

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for the clear list — answers below to help you stage the export:  

- Retention windows: for our FedRAMP low intake we need 1 year of raw logs, but auditors ask for up to 3 years for select control families (access & audit). For ISO 27001 we accept 1 year standard unless the control maps to legal/compliance obligations where 3 years may be required.
- Sampling window: please provide a static snapshot that covers the most recent 6 months (Feb 1–Jul 31, 2026). Auditors prefer a reproducible window.
- Log formats: CloudTrail JSON + signed SHA256 manifest is preferred. CSV index is fine as a table of contents; include file checksums.
- Control owners: named owners are ideal — they use the package to validate attestations during interviews. Role-only owners may slow the process.

Quick note: for any PII-related artifacts please redact before export and include a redaction manifest.

We can review the first export on Aug 21; procurement looped in for tracking.

Best,
Julia Wong
Senior Information Security Manager
Acme Analytics
[Attachment stub: Acme-SIG-reqs.pdf (pdf)]
